3-a.decision_correctness_justification: The input is synthetically constructed from the sampling rate (ops['fs'] = 30 Hz) and bin size (10 frames), not from a raw data variable. This is appropriate since the task instructions specify 'Time elapsed from the beginning of the experiment' as the decoder input, and this must be computed rather than loaded from data. The AI correctly interprets this as time from the start of each recording session.
